dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell-like phenotype by the Hans algorithm

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV, B symptoms present (IV-B), bulky disease.

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: plus non-contiguous extranodal disease in the right kidney

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms: night sweats most nights and about 11% weight loss

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: IHC MYC 20% and BCL2 30% are below the usual double-expressor thresholds

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: he is in the high-risk group on the CNS-IPI

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Start curative-intent immunochemotherapy with polatuzumab vedotin plus R-CHP (Pola-R-CHP, POLARIX regimen), 6 cycles of 21 days

tx_pola_preferred.quote: POLARIX showed improved progression-free survival over R-CHOP in IPI 2-5

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I am not recommending upfront dose reduction

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High. Right renal and left adrenal involvement are CNS-relapse risk factors on their own.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: lumbar puncture with cell count, protein, glucose, cytology and flow cytometry

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: I would reconsider it only if renal function recovers to CrCl of at least 60
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX to renal function but commits to IT MTX and does not frame prophylaxis benefit as uncertain.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: I am not using high-dose IV methotrexate

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 with residual mass needs biopsy or tumor-board decision
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Biopsy offered alongside tumor-board RT decision rather than as a firm prerequisite.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Check potassium (5.0 on lisinopril and NSAID) and phosphorus daily during admission
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: High risk recognized with hydration and rasburicase, but lab monitoring is daily rather than q6-12h.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: If G6PD is normal: rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg IV daily

sup_gcsf.quote: primary prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim each cycle

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: stop ibuprofen today and avoid all NSAIDs permanently

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Start basal insulin with correctional insulin on prednisone days

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: surface antibody positive means vaccinated and immune, so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed

work_echo_reviewed.quote: he is 67, ECOG 2 and self-caring, LVEF is 60%
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF 60% cited as supporting full doses but not explicitly as permitting anthracycline.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: I judge him fit for curative-intent full-dose R-CHP-based therapy with G-CSF, and I am not recommending upfront dose reduction.
fit_ecog_disease_related.note: Does not explicitly call ECOG 2 disease-related and conditions fitness on a pending geriatric assessment.
